crossRefs.note: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites…
These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

parallels.note: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

translations.web: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
translations.asv: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
